### MIA status bits

| Bit | Register | Name | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| 0 | `STATUS_L` | `MIA_STAT_MASTER_MODE` | 0 = loader mode, 1 = normal mode. |
| 1 | `STATUS_L` | `MIA_STAT_ERRORS` | Error queue contains at least one error. |
| 2 | `STATUS_L` | `MIA_STAT_CMD_RUNNING` | Command handler is executing queued commands. |
| 3 | `STATUS_L` | `MIA_STAT_DMA_RUNNING` | MIA RAM DMA copy is in progress. |
| 4 | `STATUS_L` | `MIA_STAT_SPEED_CHANGING` | A PHI2 speed change has been requested and not yet applied. |
| 5 | `STATUS_L` | `MIA_STAT_VIDEO_FRAME_REQUESTED` | Video client update request accepted; ACK not received yet. |
| 6 | `STATUS_L` | `MIA_STAT_VIDEO_FRAME_SENT` | Initial video response send finished; ACK may still be pending. |
| 7 | `STATUS_L` | `MIA_STAT_EXEC_PAUSED` | PHI2 is stopped by the exec pause control. |
| 8 | `STATUS_H` | `MIA_STAT_AUDIO_ACTIVE` | PWM audio IRQ is running. |
| 9 | `STATUS_H` | `MIA_STAT_SD_PRESENT` | SD card initialized successfully. This is not a physical socket-detect bit. |
| 10 | `STATUS_H` | `MIA_STAT_SD_BUSY` | SD/FS command is in progress. |
| 11 | `STATUS_H` | `MIA_STAT_FS_MOUNTED` | FAT filesystem is mounted. |
